sections.title: Species
sections.description: Lifetime tau (ns) and diffusion coefficient D (um2/ms) of the two simulated species.

sections.label: D₁ (µm²/ms)
sections.description: Translational diffusion coefficient of species 1. τ_D = w₀²/(4·D).

sections.title: Kinetics / statistics
sections.description: Exchange rate k (1/ms) between the species, number of photons and random seed.

sections.label: k (1/ms)
sections.description: Symmetric species interconversion rate (0 = static species). Set the two diffusion coefficients equal to isolate the exchange in the cross-correlation.

sections.label: Photons
sections.description: Photon budget. More photons = cleaner filtered correlations (and a slower simulation).
